edges.reason: onlyOwner modifier compares msg.sender to owner before transferOwnership body executes.
_newOwner parameter is written into the newOwner state variable.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner, an authorization gate.
newOwner value is promoted into owner, transferring privilege.
approve keys the allowance mapping on msg.sender.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens.
spender is the second key of the allowed mapping.
tokens value is stored into the allowed mapping.
transfer reads balances[msg.sender] as the debited account.
msg.sender selects the balance operand of the safeSub subtraction.
tokens parameter is the subtrahend in safeSub(balances[msg.sender], tokens).
safeSub result is stored back into balances.
recipient 'to' receives the credited balance entry.
from parameter selects the debited account in transferFrom.
tokens parameter drives the subtraction amounts in transferFrom.
to parameter receives credited tokens in transferFrom.
transferFrom uses msg.sender as the spender whose allowance is debited.
tokens parameter is subtracted from the caller allowance.
from parameter selects the allowance owner key in the safeSub call.
SafeMath result is written back into the allowed mapping.
approveAndCall sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] before the external call.
approveAndCall writes the allowance state before interacting with the callee.
approveAndCall performs an external call into a user-supplied contract, allowing reentrant entry.
spender parameter determines the external callee address.
tokens amount is forwarded to the external receiveApproval call.
arbitrary caller-supplied data is passed to the external receiveApproval call.
onlyOwner modifier gates transferAnyERC20Token on msg.sender == owner.
transferAnyERC20Token delegates execution to an external contract call.
tokenAddress parameter selects the callee contract of the external transfer.
tokens parameter is forwarded to the untrusted external ERC20 transfer.
Constructor mints _totalSupply into the deployer balance mapping.
totalSupply reads the _totalSupply state variable.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
allowance reads the allowed mapping.
transfer relies on the SafeMath safeSub require to prevent underflow.
transferFrom relies on the SafeMath safeSub require to prevent allowance underflow.
